# About Me — Amirehsan Ashoori

My name is Amirehsan Ashoori, and I'm the creator behind PICKSAW — a creative identity that brings together technology, design, art, music, and storytelling. I don't focus on a single medium. I build across whatever helps an idea come to life, whether that's a website, a 3D world, a cinematic edit, a piece of music, or an AI-generated concept.

I see creativity as one connected ecosystem where code, visuals, sound, and atmosphere work together.

## What I Create

### Web Design & Development

I design and build modern websites, interactive landing pages, and premium templates with a strong focus on visual storytelling, smooth user experience, and cinematic presentation.

### 3D Art & Unreal Engine

I create environments, experiments, and cinematic scenes in Unreal Engine, exploring procedural generation, lighting, world-building, and real-time rendering.

### AI Art & Video

I use AI as a creative tool to develop original artwork, animated concepts, character designs, live wallpapers, and visual experiments that combine imagination with technical workflows.

### Music & Sound

I experiment with music production, rap writing, atmosphere-driven compositions, and sound design as another way of telling stories beyond visuals.

### Creative Coding

I enjoy building interactive experiences where programming becomes part of the art itself — combining animation, motion, effects, and experimental interfaces.

### Branding & Visual Identity

PICKSAW is more than a logo. I develop visual identities, concepts, and creative systems that aim to make projects feel distinctive rather than generic.

## My Creative Style

My work often draws inspiration from:

- Cyberpunk and futuristic worlds
- Persian art and cultural influences
- Cinematic lighting and atmosphere
- Architecture and minimalism
- Mystery, masks, and symbolic storytelling
- Black-and-white contrasts with selective color
- Nature mixed with technology

Rather than following trends, I'm interested in creating experiences that feel memorable and emotionally atmospheric.

## The Meaning of PICKSAW

PICKSAW is my creative brand — a place where different disciplines meet. Some projects become websites, others become 3D scenes, AI films, music, or experimental concepts. The medium changes, but the goal stays the same: build something that leaves an impression.

## Picksaw products

- Main site: https://picksaw.ir/ — an immersive WebGL portfolio/storefront: a walkable real-time 3D city with a weather/atmosphere switcher (thunderstorm, sunrise and sunset, clear and cloudy), an animated 3D P logo, a holographic ghost card, template gallery, feed and game. Built with React 19, TypeScript, Vite, Tailwind CSS v4, Three.js / React Three Fiber, GLSL, Lenis and Framer Motion; fonts Sora (Latin) and Vazirmatn (Persian); works fully offline with local assets; accessible (reduced-motion, keyboard, bilingual RTL).
- Website templates (premium, bilingual-ready Persian + English): Verda (verda.picksaw.ir), Lumina (lumina.picksaw.ir), Clarity (clarity.picksaw.ir), Pulse (pulse.picksaw.ir), Aurora (aurora.picksaw.ir), Lumen (lumen.picksaw.ir).
- Game: Stormblade — stormblade.picksaw.ir.
- API: api.picksaw.ir.
